[package]
name = "avs3a"
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2024"
description = "Memory-safe AVS3-P3 (AV3A) decoder foundation"
license-file = "LICENSE.md"
rust-version = "1.96"

[lib]
name = "avs3a"
path = "src/lib.rs"

[dependencies]
rayon = "1.12.0"
rustfft = "6.4.1"
wide = "1.6.1"

[[bin]]
name = "avs3a-inspect"
path = "src/bin/avs3a-inspect.rs"

[[bin]]
name = "avs3a-decode"
path = "src/bin/avs3a-decode.rs"

[[bin]]
name = "avs3a-model-inspect"
path = "src/bin/avs3a-model-inspect.rs"

[[bin]]
name = "avs3a-mono-decode"
path = "src/bin/avs3a-mono-decode.rs"

[[bin]]
name = "avs3a-wav-compare"
path = "src/bin/avs3a-wav-compare.rs"

[profile.release]
codegen-units = 1
lto = "thin"
panic = "abort"

[profile.profiling]
inherits = "release"
debug = 1
strip = false

[lints.rust]
unsafe_code = "forbid"

[package]
name = "font-kit"
version = "0.14.3"
authors = ["Patrick Walton <pcwalton@mimiga.net>"]
description = "A cross-platform font loading library"
license = "MIT OR Apache-2.0"
readme = "README.md"
repository = "https://github.com/servo/font-kit"
homepage = "https://github.com/servo/font-kit"
exclude = ["resources/**"]
edition = "2018"
rust-version = "1.77"

[features]
default = ["source"]
loader-freetype = ["freetype-sys"]
loader-freetype-default = ["loader-freetype"]
source-fontconfig = ["yeslogic-fontconfig-sys"]
source-fontconfig-dlopen = ["yeslogic-fontconfig-sys/dlopen"]
source-fontconfig-default = ["source-fontconfig"]
source = []

[dependencies]
bitflags = "2.4"
byteorder = "1.2"
float-ord = "0.3"
libc = "0.2"
log = "0.4.4"
pathfinder_geometry = "0.5"
pathfinder_simd = "0.5.5"

[dependencies.freetype-sys]
version = "0.23"
optional = true

[dependencies.yeslogic-fontconfig-sys]
version = "6.0"
optional = true

[dev-dependencies]
clap = "4"
colored = "2"
pbr = "1.0"
prettytable-rs = "0.10"

[target."cfg(target_family = \"windows\")".dependencies.dwrote]
version = "^0.11.3"
default-features = false

[target."cfg(target_family = \"windows\")".dependencies.winapi]
version = "0.3"
features = ["dwrite", "minwindef", "sysinfoapi", "winbase", "winnt"]

[target."cfg(any(target_os = \"macos\", target_os = \"ios\"))".dependencies]
core-foundation = "0.9"
core-graphics = "0.23"
core-text = "20.1.0"

[target."cfg(not(any(target_family = \"windows\", target_os = \"macos\", target_os = \"ios\")))".dependencies]
freetype-sys = "0.23"

[target."cfg(not(any(target_family = \"windows\", target_os = \"android\", target_os = \"macos\", target_os = \"ios\", target_arch = \"wasm32\", target_env = \"ohos\")))".dependencies]
yeslogic-fontconfig-sys = "6.0"

[target."cfg(not(any(target_arch = \"wasm32\", target_family = \"windows\", target_os = \"android\", target_env = \"ohos\")))".dependencies]
dirs = "6.0"

[target."cfg(not(target_arch = \"wasm32\"))".dependencies]
walkdir = "2.1"

[source.vendored-sources]
directory = "cargo/vendor"

[source.crates-io]
replace-with = "vendored-sources"

[source."https://github.com/1254qwer/avs3a-rust"]
git = "https://github.com/1254qwer/avs3a-rust"
replace-with = "vendored-sources"
rev = "59213e47a27ffa6ba9211bac1f5a6c6fd182e9d8"

[source."https://github.com/yucling/font-kit"]
git = "https://github.com/yucling/font-kit"
replace-with = "vendored-sources"
rev = "bf5afc70b5afbcfa3de1b7e43b0ecae7524318cd"
